text:
nina: Heads-up -- travel claim question from Dublin trip. Couple things: I paid an ATM withdrawal for local cash (bank charged a 25 fee), used company card for hotel but my partner paid for one night when we extended personally. Also the hotel folio shows a VAT amount but no supplier VAT number. Can I claim the ATM fee? Can partner-night be split? And does missing supplier VAT number block VAT reclaim?
people-ops: Quick: ATM fees are generally reimbursable if you needed cash for business expenses and provide ATM receipt. Personal nights are not reimbursable; split the hotel folio or attach a note showing which dates were business. VAT reclaim depends on vendor docs & country -- missing supplier VAT number can complicate reclaim but we may still reimburse net.
nina: ATM receipt was just the ATM slip + bank fee line on my card statement (I reimbursed myself later). Is that ok as proof?
finance-jules: Yes, attach the ATM slip + the card/bank statement showing the fee and date. We'll reimburse the fee in the same currency as the claim. Mark the expense type as "cash withdrawal fee".
nina: For the partner night, hotel only issued one folio for whole stay. Can I submit one claim with two lines (business nights + personal night negative) or do we need a letter from hotel?
people-ops: Preferred: ask hotel for an itemized folio or a pro-rated invoice showing only the business nights. If they can't provide that, add a short note and manager approval.
manager-sam: I approve the pro-rated split for Nina if she adds the note and flags the claim to me. Thanks.
finance-jules: VAT: if there's no supplier VAT number we usually treat VAT as non-recoverable and reimburse the net amount. If you can get an invoice with supplier tax ID from the hotel, upload and we will attempt reclaim. We'll ping you if tax authorities need original.
nina: what about transaction descriptions in the statement that say "HOTEL*GENERIC" -- will that pass?
finance-jules: Descriptions like that are ok if the folio ties to it. Add the hotel address in the note. If ambiguous we'll ask for additional proof.
people-ops: Reminder: company card should be primary for business nights. For extensions that are personal, best practice is to pay separately or ask front desk to split at check-out.
expensify-bot: Auto-checklist: attach folio or receipt, ATM slip + bank statement, add expense notes, tag manager for approval for mixed personal nights. Claims submitted by 17:00 PT processed in ~3 business days.
nina: thanks all, I'll request itemized folio and upload ATM docs. Appreciate the quick answers :wave:
